bio: Research Background Contact Us Aliza Ray is a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design (BARD) Center. She collaborates with clinicians and researchers in multiple disease areas by providing statistical support. Aliza has a research background in ecology and marine biology. Aliza joined Boston Children’s Hospital in 2022. She earned a master’s degree in applied biostatistics from Boston University in 2022.
